summary: Pro tier deep decompilation, liquidity drain stress-testing, and privileged access audit for SafeMoon (SAFEMOON).

findings.title: Arbitrary Burn Parameter Permitting Liquidity Pool Depletion
findings.description: Publicly accessible or privileged burn mechanism allowing removal of LP tokens from Uniswap/PancakeSwap pair without timelock.

attackSurface.attackVector: Owner private key compromise or malicious insider drains $8.9M by invoking burn on liquidity pair.

remediation.recommendedAction: Apply verified check-effects-interactions, enforce timelocks, and guard critical state variables.
